sentences.text: At September 29, 2024, we had $15.0 billion of principal fixed-rate notes outstanding, $1.4 billion of which matures in May 2025.
The remaining debt has maturity dates in 2027 through 2053.
Our aggregate principal debt obligations were $1.8 billion as of December 28, 2024.
Our 2.95% Notes with a principal amount of $750 million were repaid in June 2024 and our remaining debt will mature starting in 2030.
